purpose: Grouped Founder decisions required before any destructive cleanup proceeds

decisions.topic: Foundation Communication Site — retain or consolidate
decisions.current_state: sites/foundation_comm exists as a standalone communication site. No Team or Group. Low activity (last September 2025). Has Programs & Events folder structure.

decision_options.A: RETAIN — this is the public-facing or informational communication site for the JM Merrill Foundation (e.g., intranet landing page or external-facing portal). Document its purpose and distinguish it from foundation_div.
decision_options.B: CONSOLIDATE — this site is an orphaned legacy build. Migrate Programs & Events content to sites/foundation_div and retire the standalone site.

decisions.recommendation: Option B if the site has no active external audience. Option A if it serves as the Foundation's public communication presence.
decisions.consequence: Option A: Two Foundation sites; must document distinct purposes clearly. Option B: One Foundation site; requires content migration and owner confirmation.
decisions.cost_security_impact: Low — no licensing or security-boundary implication
decisions.blocker_if_deferred: foundation_comm remains unclassified; no cleanup action is safe

decisions.topic: Enterprise canon location — ImplementationHQ vs. publishing dual presence
decisions.current_state: PROGRAM-004 entity evidence and enterprise governance documents exist in both sites/ImplementationHQ/Architecture/00_CANON and sites/publishing/JM1 Shared Services/Enterprise Governance.

decision_options.A: ImplementationHQ/Architecture/00_CANON is the single authoritative enterprise canon location. Publishing site's Enterprise Governance folder becomes a reference copy with a clear header note pointing to ImplementationHQ.
decision_options.B: Both are authoritative for their respective scopes — ImplementationHQ for architecture/governance, Publishing for publishing-specific entity evidence. Document the split scope explicitly.

decisions.recommendation: Option A — simpler canonical rule. Option B is acceptable if Publishing regularly needs to update entity evidence independently.
decisions.consequence: Without a decision: automation or editors may write to the wrong location, creating version drift.
decisions.blocker_if_deferred: Canon duplication continues; document authority unclear

decisions.current_state: sites/projects is a large Team-connected site containing mirrored dev repo content (JS bundles, Next.js build outputs, branch checkouts for jm1-agape, jmerrill-pub, etc.). Last significant activity January 2026. GitHub and the HOST-02 App Service estate are now authoritative for all code.

decision_options.A: ARCHIVE and CLEAN — remove build artifacts and repo mirrors from SharePoint. Keep the Projects Team shell if Projects collaboration continues. Retain any unique files not in GitHub.
decision_options.B: RETAIN AS-IS — leave the SharePoint dev store intact as a historical snapshot archive.
decision_options.C: RETIRE FULLY — retire both the content and the Projects Team/site if Projects collaboration has ended.

decisions.recommendation: Option A — clean artifacts, retain Team shell until Projects Team need is confirmed.
decisions.consequence: Option B: ongoing storage waste and ambiguity about canonical code location. Option C: loss of any unique archived state not captured in GitHub.
decisions.cost_security_impact: Storage reduction; no licensing or security boundary impact
decisions.blocker_if_deferred: Dev artifact confusion continues; SharePoint and GitHub may diverge further

decisions.topic: Sales Team and Voicemail Team — confirm active collaboration need
decisions.current_state: Sales Team: last SharePoint activity September 2025 (pricing sheets only). Voicemail Team: last SharePoint activity March 2025; functional voicemail routing may depend on the Team identity.

Sales.A: RETAIN — Sales Team is actively used for collaboration or will be in near future.
Sales.B: ARCHIVE — Sales collaboration has ended; retire Team, site, and Group after confirming no dependency.

Voicemail.A: RETAIN — voicemail routing requires the Team identity or the mailbox. Do not touch.
Voicemail.B: DECOUPLE AND ARCHIVE — if routing can be moved to a standalone shared mailbox (voicemail@jmerrill.pub already exists), retire the Team shell.

decisions.recommendation: Sales: Jackie confirms. Voicemail: confirm technical routing dependency before any action.
decisions.consequence: Premature archival of Voicemail Team could break voicemail delivery. Premature Sales archival loses the Team if collaboration restarts.
decisions.blocker_if_deferred: Teams remain in LOW/INACTIVE state with unclear destiny

decisions.topic: Shared mailbox set — confirm operational use
decisions.current_state: Seven shared mailboxes exist whose active use is unconfirmed (usage reports 403): accounting@, board@, donations@, grants@, media@, volunteers@, contacts@. Legal, preneeds, royalties, submissions, tech, info, no-reply, notifications, logging already classified KEEP — CORE.

For each mailbox.A: KEEP — CORE: receives external email, serves a distinct operational audience, or is an automation target.
For each mailbox.B: KEEP — ALIAS: retained as a vanity/forwarding alias but not actively managed. No cleanup needed but no staffing required.
For each mailbox.C: RETIRE: no active use, no external audience, no automation dependency. Remove or redirect.

decisions.recommendation: Jackie reviews each. Suggest keeping board@, donations@, grants@ at minimum for Foundation credibility. accounting@ and media@ depend on active use.
decisions.consequence: Unused mailboxes are low-cost but may create confusion for external parties. Retiring an active mailbox breaks incoming mail.
decisions.cost_security_impact: Shared mailboxes are typically unlicensed; low cost impact

decisions.topic: Projects Team — confirm ongoing collaboration need
decisions.current_state: Projects Team has a SharePoint site with legacy dev content. The Team itself may or may not have active collaboration (meetings, channel posts) beyond the document store.

decision_options.A: RETAIN Team — Projects collaboration is ongoing (planning, coordination) regardless of SharePoint content state.
decision_options.B: ARCHIVE Team — Projects collaboration has moved to GitHub Issues/Projects or other tools; retire the Team shell.

decisions.recommendation: Confirm with Jackie whether active planning or coordination happens in the Projects Team channel.
decisions.consequence: Premature archival removes a collaboration space. Retention of an empty Team adds clutter.
